summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his tenth cycle of high-dose methotrexate since CNS lymphoma relapse, marking the sixth maintenance dose and third bimonthly administration. He tolerated the chemotherapy infusion well without complications. His candidal chest rash continued to improve, and he remained neurologically stable with no new deficits. Methotrexate levels were monitored and cleared appropriately, reaching 0.06 before discharge. Liver enzymes rose transiently as expected. Aspirin, omeprazole, and fluconazole were held during treatment and restarted at discharge. A brain MRI showed no new enhancing lesions, indicating stable disease. He was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up scheduled in three months.
